verdicts.notes: Confirmed 100%. Additionally noted that voice.ts:269-277 (rl.on('line')) and voice.ts:292-298 (pumpWarmSynthQueue stdout.once('data')) BOTH call warmSynthQueue.shift() on the same queue and mix readline line-buffering with raw stdout 'data' events.

Confirmed 100%: gem_kursor_ triggers immediate fallback in GeminiTranscriber.cs:356-360, raw AIza... keys are rejected by BidiGenerateContentConstrained with Authorization: Token, and RunBatchAsync bypasses /v2/dictation/cleanup.
Confirmed 100%: voice.ts:823-826 returns HTTP 200 with hardcoded 'Hello from Kursor local dictation transcription.' whenever audioBuffer.byteLength <= 44 or all STT providers fail.
Confirmed 100%: when ReadValue returns null (common in Electron/Chromium/terminals), landed is null, verification is 'unverifiable', and RestoreClipboard empties the clipboard after 250ms.

Confirmed 100%: voice.ts:504-517 reads contextObj.process_name and contextObj.window_title while DictationTranscriptionClient.cs:151-185 sends app_name, before_text, selected_text, after_text, single_line, site_host, and known_terms. Also noted comment vs model mismatch (llama-3.3-70b-versatile in comment at line 453 vs openai/gpt-oss-120b at line 532).
Confirmed 100%: 64-entry ring buffer has no overflow check and EnqueueClick races between hook thread and UI thread.
Confirmed 100%: line 469 'if (!cleaned) return raw.trim();' returns raw filler words when input is 100% fillers, and lines 472-477 unconditionally capitalize and append a period.
Confirmed 100%: ReplacingEmDashesForInsertion runs unconditionally across all apps.

Confirmed eager module-load spawn of powershell.exe at lines 314-320 with no process.on('exit'|'SIGINT'|'SIGTERM') cleanup. Precision note: warmSynthProc.on('exit') at lines 281-283 does drain warmSynthQueue.
Confirmed 100%: SendMaskKey injects VK__none_ (0xFF) on every DictationDown when Win is in the chord.
Confirmed 100%: single-token count equality and IsDistinctiveLearnableWord uppercase/underscore requirement.

Confirmed 100%: EARS_PRIMARY_PROVIDER and DICTATION_CLEANUP_PROVIDER ignored, 3-letter language codes dropped at line 705, keyterms/language ignored in /v2/dictation/gemini-token, and handleRealtimeSession catch block returns raw openAiKey ('sk-...') which bypasses RealtimeMouth.cs:355 fallback.

newFindings.title: DictationController.SetUpSessionAsync drops UIA context keyterms (BeforeText/SelectedText/AfterText) on cold starts for DictationTranscriptionClient and on warm starts for GeminiTranscriber
newFindings.remediation: Set newClient.KnownTerms = list unconditionally outside the 'if (adopted != null)' branch in SetUpSessionAsync.

newFindings.title: GeminiTranscriber.FinishAsync sets finishSent = true before queued audio finishes uploading, causing intermediate inputTranscription events to truncate utterances
newFindings.remediation: Gate early resolution of delivered in HandleMessage (line 750) on activityEndSent.Task.IsCompleted rather than finishSent.

newFindings.title: DeepgramTranscriber leaks ArrayPool<byte>.Shared buffers when BoundedChannelFullMode.DropOldest drops frames and during DisposeAsync
newFindings.remediation: Use BoundedChannelFullMode.Wait and drain outgoing.Reader in DisposeAsync() to return pooled buffers to ArrayPool<byte>.Shared.
